a:

you wrote:

i tried to write my college course in an english textbook using word, but it is not good.

i would like to help you by writing you a sentence using "word" that looks good.
what the sentence is trying to say is that the writer of the textbook uses one of the most common ways to write english, but in a way which doesn't show the writer's mastery of idiomatic english. this is a subtle way of saying that the writer is ignorant of idiomatic english.
